ios.desc:
We're dedicated to building the world's best AI app for language learning.

Traditional apps build vocabulary. Langua builds confidence to speak - through immersive practice with intelligent AI that sounds authentic, corrects naturally, and adapts to your level.

WHY LEARNERS CHOOSE LANGUA

Maria C.: "I LOVE Langua! I've been using it daily for months. The chat feature is fantastic - it feels like talking to a real, empathetic language partner who corrects me and suggests more advanced phrasing. It's pressure-free and I'm encouraged by how much I'm improving both my intermediate German and my more basic Italian. I taught French for 27 years and have learned Spanish on my own in recent years. This is a fantastic tool for practicing speaking."

Guy S: "Langua's AI is very sophisticated and, so far at least, not at all robotic. The conversations feel authentic. The AI provides very helpful feedback on each conversation and gives tips for improvement. Langua is invaluable for language learners like me who can't frequently visit the country where their target language is spoken."

Featured in The Guardian and recommended by leading polyglots including Luca Lampariello, Olly Richards and English with Lucy.

THE BEST AI FOR LANGUAGE LEARNING THROUGH CONVERSATION

Unlike apps that rely on multiple choice or scripted dialogues, Langua uses advanced conversational AI that lets you express yourself freely across 20+ languages:

• Unlimited speaking practice with remarkably realistic AI characters - many cloned from YouTubers we partner with. Choose from multiple dialects.

• Call Mode for hands-free practice: Have real-time voice conversations while driving, walking, or relaxing. No typing needed.

• Instant corrections with explanations: Get feedback in one tap or review detailed reports after each chat.

• Speak your native language when stuck: Can't find the right word? Switch languages mid-conversation and the AI will help you learn the phrase.

• Huge conversation library: Roleplays, debates, grammar practice, vocabulary building, or free conversation about your interests.

ADAPTS TO ALL LEVELS

Whether you're just starting or already conversational, Langua adapts to you. Zero pressure to perform perfectly - our intelligent support features let you converse confidently at any level:

• Reply suggestions when you're not sure what to say
• Instant translations with usage examples
• Innovative guided conversation course for beginners

quotes.text:
There are some new AI apps out there that I would put in the “hack” category for being a lot  more effective than all the stuff I used in the past (which also included Duolingo, Anki, etc). The one I used the most over three months to refresh my Spanish is Langua (bad name with too much competition, but I put the link below).

This app, and I’m sure others, is a polished “overlay” of sorts on top of one LLM or another, but it’s very well done. By far the best way of learning a language is conversation with a native speaker. This puts 90% of that in your pocket on demand. You can chat (out loud) on various topics, or any topic, and this is augmented with various tools, way to save words to a vocabulary list with a flash card UI, etc. After each conversation you get an evaluation. I found it a lot more fun, and a lot more effective, than anything else I’ve tried.

https://apps.apple.com/ca/app/langua-ai-language-learning/id6737520234
